release_notes: Bugfix-and-performance release porting the tester's addendum V — the 14 items real in this repository. Metrics: the Visitors column finally counts visitors — visitors was a duplicate alias of SUM(uniq_global) at four query sites, so the panel could show Clicks higher than Visitors, an impossible relationship; it is now COUNT over the same filtered rows with uniqueness in its own column, and the Campaigns totals row gained visitors/unique-clicks keys plus cpv/epv/eCPC/eCPM formulas mirroring the backend (the old frontend copies divided by lp_views and disagreed with per-row values). Backend: the deferred DNS refresh introduced in v1.3.5 prepares its UPDATE per iteration with a locked-retry — a statement reused across the resolver's own queries failed with SQLITE error 21 on FPM and refreshed only the first domain; the same prepared-per-connection fix applies to the ad-connection loop. New: ad-entity status cache (schema 40) — the report's play-pause toggles answer from a 5-minute success / 15-minute failure cache instead of one live Graph call per entity per report open, which under a rate limit never cleared the limit; panel toggles invalidate their row. Panel: the 10-second 7-endpoint poll now runs only on the Dashboard tab, at 15s, paused while the tab is hidden — roughly 60k requests a day off the single SQLite writer, and the real cause of 'reports are slow'; the date range survives reloads and navigation (localStorage on Campaigns, sessionStorage in the report overlay; presets are stored by id and re-derived, and the picker highlights the right chip through the new initialPreset prop); the report overlay is mirrored in the URL hash (#report, #report/<id>) so a refresh returns to the same report; the Campaigns Actions column is sized for its four controls instead of three; the Namecheap toolbar buttons render disabled until the status resolves instead of popping in and reflowing the toolbar; rotation rows wrap below sm so the name and badges get their own line (at phone width the three fixed-width siblings squeezed the name out entirely); the rotation toolbar group wraps at all five schema sites; the Conditions popover is a bottom sheet below lg; the date picker panel is a bottom sheet below sm with non-shrinkable preset chips. Left out by decision: the metric-semantics rewrite (pinned by tests as the operator's v0.9.9.2 resolution), the safe-page per-campaign exclusion (the tester's own port broke his panel and was reverted), and the bot-feed feature suite.
